source_title: TrendForce Expects NAND Flash Prices to Keep Rising During 2017 as Industry’s Wafer Capacity Will Expand by Just 6% Annually
claim_relevant_visible_text: The global NAND Flash industry will see an annual increase of just 6% in its total wafer capacity in 2017
researcher_paraphrase: DRAMeXchange forecast only about 6% annual growth in total NAND wafer capacity for 2017 while the industry was migrating toward 3D NAND.
precision_guard: This is a December 2016 industry forecast for 2017 NAND wafer capacity, not a realized wafer-capacity Outcome.
authority_boundary: TrendForce/DRAMeXchange is methodological-primary for its own NAND market forecast, not a primary manufacturer capacity ledger.
